title: Constructibility of normalized integral extension
statement: Let ell and p be distinct primes, k a field of characteristic p, and W a separated finite-type k-scheme. Let a:Z→W be a locally closed immersion with Z finite type over k. For a finite subextension E of the fixed ell-adic algebraic closure and a lisse finite free integral coefficient module M on Z, the normalized locally closed extension H of M[0], transported by the normalized coefficient geometry G to internal module derived categories, is bounded constructible on W. H is coherent and uses the actual pro-etale module inverse images and direct images of [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence]. Coefficients and lisseness are those of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-sfb-lisse-coefficient-module]; bounded constructibility is that of [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-normalized-integral-heart-extension-constructible] to the module obtained by the internal-to-sectionwise equivalence, the exact module extension H and the inverse equivalence. The three mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor isomorphisms identify scalarSixExtension applied to M[0] with this constructible module in degree zero. Its cohomology in degree zero is that module, and it vanishes in all other degrees. The zero modules have rank-zero finite presentations on the one-stratum stratification. Therefore this single complex is bounded constructible in [0,0]. Transport boundedness and every constructible cohomology module along the displayed isomorphism.

theorem normalized_integral_extension_constructible
    (ell p : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime] [Fact p.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] (hne : ell ≠ p)
    (H : LocallyClosedExtensionData.{u}) (hH : H.Coherent)
    (G : ScalarSixGeometry.{u})
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ell)
    (W Z : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType W.hom] [QuasiCompact W.hom] [IsSeparated W.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom]
    (a : Z ⟶ W) [IsImmersion a.left]
    (M : ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules
      (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) Z.left)
    (hM : IsLisseCoefficientModule (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) M) :
    boundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1) W.left)
      ((scalarSixExtension H G (⟨Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ell E.1⟩ : ScalarSixRing) a).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
